description: Source code for Data Access Object (DAO) classes related to datasets in Apache Superset, including filtering, validation, and update methods for tables, columns, and metrics.

classes.name: DatasetDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object for datasets, supporting filtering, validation, and update operations.

classes.name: DatasetColumnDAO
classes.description: DAO for dataset columns, inherits base DAO.

classes.name: DatasetMetricDAO
classes.description: DAO for dataset metrics, inherits base DAO.

methods.name: apply_column_operators
methods.description: Overrides to handle filtering by database_name via subquery on Database.

methods.name: get_database_by_id
methods.description: Fetches a Database object by its ID.

methods.name: get_related_objects
methods.description: Retrieves charts and dashboards related to a specific database ID.

methods.name: validate_table_exists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: validate_uniqueness
methods.description: Validates that a table's name, schema, and catalog are unique within a database.

methods.name: validate_update_uniqueness
methods.description: Validates that updating a table does not violate uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: validate_columns_exist
methods.description: Checks if specified columns exist in a dataset.

methods.name: validate_columns_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if column names are unique within a dataset.

methods.name: validate_metrics_exist
methods.description: Checks if specified metrics exist in a dataset.

methods.name: validate_metrics_uniqueness
methods.description: Checks if metric names are unique within a dataset.

methods.name: validate_python_date_format
methods.description: Validates if a date format string is valid.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a dataset record, including columns and metrics.

methods.name: update_columns
methods.description: Creates, updates, or deletes columns based on provided list.

methods.name: update_metrics
methods.description: Creates, updates, or deletes metrics based on provided list.

methods.name: find_dataset_column
methods.description: Finds a specific column in a dataset.

methods.name: find_dataset_metric
methods.description: Finds a specific metric in a dataset.

methods.name: get_table_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a table object by database ID and table name.

methods.name: get_filterable_columns_and_operators
methods.description: Returns filterable columns and operators, including custom fields.
